profile.name: ITU-R BT.2100-3 Hybrid Log-Gamma scene OETF

negative_controls_required: scene-linear inputs below zero or above one must reject
encoded signal values below zero or above one must reject
do not apply the display OOTF or assume system gamma in the scene OETF
do not label scene-linear output as cd/m2 or physical display luminance
published rounded constants must not cause endpoint drift outside the declared domain
limitations: UNQUALIFIED analytical fixture; the fixture contract must execute before it is considered software-qualified.
This tests only the HLG scene-referred OETF and its inverse.
Display-side OOTF/EOTF, system gamma, display peak luminance, black-level lift, viewing surround and physical panel response are not modeled.
No HDR display, camera, photometer or physical system was measured.
